mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OP_MANAGER_ACTION_LOG ( LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_TYPE, REQUEST_URI, REQUEST_METHOD, REMOTE_ADDR, CREATED_DATE ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{loginType}, #{requestUri}, #{requestMethod}, #{remoteAddr}, #{createdDate} )

where.if: AND AL.LOGIN_ID = (SELECT LOGIN_ID FROM OP_LOGIN_LOG WHERE LOGIN_LOG_ID = #{loginLogId})

mapper.select: /** manager-action-log-mapper.getManagerActionLogListCountByParam (관리자 메뉴 사용 이력 관리 갯수 조회) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OP_MANAGER_ACTION_LOG AL

where.if: AND AL.LOGIN_ID = (SELECT LOGIN_ID FROM OP_USER_LOGIN_LOG WHERE LOGIN_LOG_ID = #{loginLogId})

mapper.select: /** manager-action-log-mapper.getUserActionLogListCountByParam (사용자 메뉴 사용 이력 관리 갯수 조회) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OP_USER_ACTION_LOG AL
